request.prompt_preview: CASE FILE Question: Customers in Tunis and Sfax complained yesterday around lunchtime that web pages and apps would not load, even though their phones showed full signal. What was going on? Now: 2026-

parsed.title: Core DNS degradation causing app and web loading failures
parsed.root_cause_summary: Core DNS node degradation caused query success rates to drop and resolution latency to spike, leading to nationwide app and web loading failures.
parsed.confidence_reason: Direct DNS alarms and metric drops observed on CORE-DNS-01, but maintenance calendar and external events were not checked.
parsed.impact_summary: Customers experienced app and web loading failures across Tunis and Sfax due to core DNS degradation.

timeline.event: Software upgrade patch applied to CORE-DNS-01.
Core DNS alert on query success percentage drop and resolution latency spike.
Major DNS_TIMEOUT_RATE alarm raised on CORE-DNS-01.

findings.claim: Core DNS query success percentage dropped and resolution latency spiked starting at 12:00.
A major DNS timeout rate alarm was raised on CORE-DNS-01 at 12:30.
A software upgrade was applied to CORE-DNS-01 at 11:00, preceding the degradation by 60 minutes.
Core DNS degradation explains widespread app and web loading failures.

hypotheses.reason: Directly evidenced by resolution latency spikes, query success drops, and major DNS timeout alarms starting at 12:00.
The 60-minute gap between the change at 11:00 and degradation at 12:00 does not directly support a bad change.

dismissed_signals.reason: Occurred later in the evening on 2026-09-02 and does not match the lunchtime customer complaint window.
Occurred on 2026-09-03, outside the incident impact window.

recommended_actions: Investigate the internal state of CORE-DNS-01 during the DNS timeout rate spike.
Check maintenance calendar for any overlapping planned activities.
Verify DNS query success rates and latency metrics post-incident.
